_comment: Machine-readable ledger of the counts this repository cites. tools/check_claims.py validates it for internal consistency and against the prose in README.md and blog/mimo-v2.6-rl.html. Values were read from the released dataset and the Docker Hub tag listing; see evidence/VERIFICATION.md for the commands.

source.report: MiMo-V2.6: Scaling Reinforcement Learning Towards Self-Improvement

image_families.sharing: 64 terminal_bench tasks get one each; 925 general_agent tasks share general-agent-env-0
all 2093 tasks share a single image

code_cyber_ledger._comment: The two domains where images and tasks correspond exactly. check_claims.py asserts these hold in both directions.

upstream_presence._comment: HTTP status from api.github.com for verl-project/verl at ref v0.9.0. 404 means the path does not exist upstream, i.e. the file is specific to the XiaomiMiMo fork. Copyright headers on all four read 'ByteDance Ltd. and/or its affiliates' locally.

anonymisation._comment: The fork's comments refer to an unnamed 'reference RL framework'. The report never uses this phrase. Report section 6.4 names the system instead.
anonymisation.report_names_instead: MiMo-V2-Flash RL and OPD infrastructure, with SGLang (inference) and Megatron-LM (training)

absences._comment: Claims the report makes that the open-source stack does not implement. Stated plainly in the blog so the boundary is explicit rather than implied.

router_freeze._comment: Report section 5.4, MiMo-V2.6-Pro, decoder layer 9, 384 experts. Loads normalised per step.

multi_harness._comment: config/agent/code/mix-four-whitebox.yaml plus the per-arm configs in config/agent/code/.
multi_harness.group_binding: one GRPO group stays on one arm; samples rotate across arms between steps

environment_injected._comment: Recipe for reproducing the two external clones the evidence refers to.
